officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: Official HÖ13 sources describe an easy medium-difficulty section from Sävsjö to Forsa. The route passes the Skrapstad grave field with shelter overnighting, has water at Djurgårdsstugan, and ends at the Forsa/Bringetofta/Tofta bathing-place and mill-culture area. Official prose says the surface is mostly path with some gravel road and that grazing animals may occur.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: HÖ13 leaves the Sävsjö side at Eksjöhovgårdssjön and passes Djurgårdsområdet before continuing north toward Skrapstad and Forsa. It is a shorter, easy-walking stage with a reliable official water point near Djurgårdsstugan, a shelter and grill at Skrapstad, and a useful endpoint service cluster at Forsa badplats. The start has good Sävsjö access through nearby bus stops and the official unmarked connector to Sävsjö C; the Forsa end is rural and works best by car, bike, taxi or planned pickup. Recheck the 2026-04-07 Storm Dave notice before relying on the Eksjöhovgårdssjön/Djurgårdsområdet start area, and treat all fireplaces as day-of-use decisions because fire risk is dynamic.

campingAndFire.summary: Skrapstad has the main on-route overnight shelter for HÖ13. Forsa has a shelter/grill endpoint cluster and Bockudden is an optional off-route detour shelter near the Sävsjö start. No designated tent site was found. Fire use must follow live restrictions and same-day fire-risk guidance.

fireRules: Live fire-ban layer showed no formal fire ban for Sävsjö/Jönköpings län on 2026-04-29, but Sävsjö municipality published a same-day warning for increased fire risk.
Do not encode no-ban status statically. Recheck fire-ban and fire-risk status before import or trip guidance.
Use established fireplaces only when permitted, avoid fire on rock/slabs, and follow any local signage.

tenting.notes: No designated tent site found for HÖ13. Ordinary allemansrätten applies unless local signs or temporary restrictions say otherwise; avoid homes, cultivation and sensitive land.

protectedAreas.methodSummary: Rules lane checked Naturvårdsverket/Länsstyrelsen WFS layers against the GPX corridor and found no formal nature reserve, Natura 2000 or water-protection area intersecting the route.
protectedAreas.caveats: Nearby protected-area hits are false positives if a broad bbox is used. Use GPX geometry for restriction scoping.

closuresAndCurrentness.summary: Storm Dave caused fallen trees on municipal land. Eksjöhovgårdssjön motion loop and Hägneskolan school forest were fully closed, and Djurgårdsområdet tracks were affected with advice not to visit them at that time.
closuresAndCurrentness.relevance: Directly relevant to HÖ13 start and Djurgårdsstugan water approach; not a confirmed whole-HÖ13 closure.

closuresAndCurrentness.summary: Same-day municipal fire-risk warning: ground was very dry and rescue services warned of increased fire risk.
closuresAndCurrentness.relevance: Relevant to Skrapstad/Forsa/Bockudden fireplaces even if no formal fire ban is active.

dogsAndLivestock: Official HÖ13 description says grazing animals may occur; close gates and keep dogs under control around livestock.
2026-04-29 is inside the 1 March-20 August period when dogs must be kept under especially strict control around wildlife; leash is the conservative import guidance.
rulesAndSafety.huntingForestry: No HÖ13-specific hunting or forestry closure was found. Keep general caution for temporary local signage, active forestry and hunting seasons.
rulesAndSafety.waterSafety: Only Djurgårdsstugan is confirmed as potable water, with time and winter-off caveats. Surface water and bathing-water locations should not be treated as drinking water.

researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory, HÖ13 API id 128405, official GPX metrics, adjacent endpoint gaps, and baseline nearby object inventory. Baseline found 470 GPX/API v2 points, 10.882311 km, HÖ12-HÖ13 gap 6.05 m and HÖ13-HÖ14 gap 2.11 m.
All six required lanes completed. No targeted second batch was needed; remaining issues are explicit import caveats rather than unresolved source holes.

Main thread checked Forsa/Toftabadet endpoint subrecords, including Naturkartan API 128308 for Rastplats Toftabadet and API 141605 for Forssa Kvarnagård, and cross-checked municipal badplats/currentness sources.

Main thread synthesized HÖ13 into this section JSON. The section is ready for normalization with caveats for start-area storm damage, dynamic fire risk, weak Forsa public transport, Forsa endpoint deduplication/aliasing, and pending OSM-only shelter verification.

openQuestions: Recheck Sävsjö municipality after 2026-04-29 for a reopening/clearing notice for Eksjöhovgårdssjön and Djurgårdsområdet before user-facing import.
Verify the OSM-only shelter/fireplace near km 8.2 against a current official source or field report before importing.
Resolve Forsa endpoint deduplication: Forsa badplats aggregate, Rastplats Toftabadet, Forsabadet shelter, toilet, parking and swimming should not create duplicate clutter.
Confirm whether the Forsabadet shelter subcoordinate should be represented as a separate shelter or merged into the Forsa/Toftabadet service cluster.
Verify exact current public transport options for the Forsa endpoint on the intended travel date; no close fixed-route stop was found.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ13 has navigation-grade official GPX geometry, clear official endpoints, good official facility coverage, and sufficient commute/rules/currentness research for normalization. Caveats remain for start-area Storm Dave damage, dynamic fire risk, weak Forsa transit, Forsa endpoint facility deduplication, and one OSM-only shelter candidate.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ14 Forsa-Vikskvarn. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
